definitions.explanation: A tall perennial grass native to Japan with silvery plumes. It is a symbol of autumn and is traditionally displayed during the moon-viewing festival (tsukimi).

examples.japanese: すすき⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{風|かぜ}→風：00641_kaze⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{揺|ゆ}れている→揺れる：01161_yureru⟧。
examples.english: The pampas grass is swaying in the wind.

examples.japanese: ⟦{月見|つきみ}→月見：13001_tsukimi⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧すすき⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{飾|かざ}る→飾る：01185_kazaru⟧。
examples.english: We decorate with pampas grass for moon viewing.

examples.japanese: ⟦{秋|あき}→秋：02276_aki⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{高原|こうげん}→高原：05497_kougen⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{一面|いちめん}→一面：11184_ichimen⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧すすき⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{広|ひろ}がり→広がる：01980_hirogaru⟧、⟦{銀色|ぎんいろ}→銀色：05068_giniro⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{輝|かがや}いていた→輝く：02032_kagayaku⟧。
examples.english: The highland in autumn was covered with pampas grass, shining silver.

notes:
The kanji form is {薄|すすき} or {芒|すすき}, but hiragana or katakana (ススキ) is more common.

CULTURAL NOTE:
すすき is one of the ⟦{秋|あき}→秋：02276_aki⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{七草|ななくさ}→七草：11190_nanakusa⟧ (seven grasses of autumn) and is closely associated with ⟦{月見|つきみ}→月見：13001_tsukimi⟧ (moon viewing). It is traditionally displayed alongside {月見団子|つきみだんご} during the mid-autumn festival.
